summary: zero-baileys 3.5.0: child_process + https co-occurrence in media utility
details: zero-baileys is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library. lib/Utils/messages-media.js imports child_process at line 28 and performs an https.request POST later in the same file. These primitives co-occur in a media-handling module where native tool dispatch (ffmpeg/sharp) and HTTP downloads/uploads of media are the module's documented purpose. No specific installer-side secret read, no hardcoded attacker-controlled destination, and no install/import-time execution path tying these primitives to installer harm have been identified; evidence is limited to keyword proximity in a utility file.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
